basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming Mediterranean-inspired style gem in the Sunset district. This rare semi-detached beauty offers an abundance of space with five bedrooms and a bonus den, a unique find in this sought-after neighborhood. The living room and formal dining room are generously sized, providing the perfect setting for family gathering and entertaining guests.       The bright bedrooms on the main floor feature soft, comfortable carpeting, creating an inviting ambiance that's both cozy and practical for daily living. On the ground level by the garage, you will find a bonus unit designed for privacy and flexibility, making it ideal for extended family, guests, or potential rental income.       From the warm stucco facade to the inviting bay window, this home exudes character and classic Sunset appeal. It's ideally situated for those seeking both tranquility and convenience, with easy access to local parks, renowned schools, and the best of neighborhood shopping and dining. This spacious Sunset retreat is ready to welcome you home.
